notes: The showcase session's world events (Tools/showcase_backend.py, docs/showcase.md), in scenario seconds after Start. Each is on a road shuttles of the integrated exercise drive, ahead of them: a pedestrian in front of shuttle-03 and shuttle-05, a road closure that asks shuttle-04 (and shuttle-02) for a decision, a signal fault at the next lights of shuttle-02 and shuttle-04, a breakdown on the return roads every shuttle-01 detour rejoins (so the 3D follow camera reaches it whatever detour is drawn; it lasts long enough for that), and a collision ahead of shuttle-03 and shuttle-05 once shuttle-03's battery has run low. Rows have the shape of predefined_scenarios.json's timeline. random_generation replaces those keys of predefined_scenarios.json's policy, so random events also come sooner.
